GrowthIntel 2.5.28 — A little market break

We’re enhancing GrowthIntel. We’ll be back soon.

Enjoy an offline Bull or Bear? chart game while you wait. Read simulated candlestick trends, build your score and keep a streak going. The complete app opens automatically when the service is ready.

Install this APK over your current GrowthIntel app. Keep the existing app installed; this update uses the same application ID and signing certificate.

ota.releaseNotes: Connection recovery, paged history and member search, lighter live updates and transfer usage reporting.
